conceptual_change: Implement a volatility-adjusted exit threshold by substituting the static stop-loss with a trailing stop based on the 14-period ATR relative to its 20-period moving average to dynamically manage drawdown during high volatility expansion.
evidence_sources: research/BTCUSDT_1h_result_v2.json: dataset and baseline execution provenance
rationale: The failure in BC 11 was procedural due to unexecutable logic; implementing the ATR-based trailing stop as defined in the previous design allows for the systematic testing of volatility-adaptive exit criteria against the baseline results.
